rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the opening remarks of the press conference titled 安倍内閣総理大臣記者会見 and dated 28 August 2020, 安倍晋三 said that, after the recurrence of his chronic illness, he had judged he should not remain in the post and would resign the office of Prime Minister (総理大臣の職を辞することといたします).

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12). A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role: an unnamed statement or schedule row, a House of Councillors designee who never held the office, or a designation of acting ministers.
